note:
Sixteen figure rows and seventeen tables over 76 measured regions on 34 of 44 pages, plus 43 refusals. Families: table-grid 17, flowchart-or-schematic 3, bar 3, line 3, other 3, scatter 2, photo-or-raster-image 1, map-or-plan-view 1.

Coverage gap that cannot become a row. Seven numbered tables print with no measured region: Table 4 on page 15 (its caption band is boxed as a 25-path fragment and the grid below it was never boxed), Table 10 on page 25, Tables 13, 14 and 15 on page 30, Table 16 on page 31 and Table 20 on page 36 - every one of those pages has zero regions except page 15. All seven are visibly ruled, each with the same three-rule house style (heavy rule under the caption, double rule under the header, heavy closing rule, no verticals), and they print at 158 to 437 pt of a 595 pt page, so the region pass had no enclosing box to key on. Numbers they carry: 4 is one data row against a twelve-label header, 10 is two gender rows, 13 and 14 are the football and softball top fives, 15 is the baseball top five mis-titled 'Softball Coach Ranking' with Ron Fraser printed twice, 16 is the Chinese top five, and 20 is a two-column nine-row before/after list whose header label prints 'Ranking before adjustment' over both columns. With those seven declared, the paper's 22 numbered tables and 2 unnumbered appendix blocks are all accounted for by 15 numbered rows and 2 unnumbered rows.

Declared decisions. (1) The page-2 execution flow chart is one exhibit boxed twice, and the detector also boxes its side label and the three arrows, which are fragments. (2) Figure 1's three panels are photographs boxed six times and Figure 2's two flanking pictures twice; one row each, panels 3 and 1, the repeats refused as duplicates or fragments. (3) Table 3's region is the header band only - the eleven factor rows below it are unruled text with no bottom rule. (4) Table 6's region holds its heading, caption, header and first body row, with rows 2 to 10 printing outside the box. (5) Tables 17 to 19 carry a coach photograph inside the Name column of every row; the twelve portraits are fragments of those three tables and one of them is printed above the closing rule of the next table. (6) Fig 12 and Table 22 each cross a page: the map is boxed twice over and Table 22's seven remaining pairs are a split-across-pages refusal. (7) The appendix is two 60-row dumps - 'Original Data' and 'Modified Data' - each split over three pages and each recorded as one unnumbered table with three refusals.

Recorded defects. 'Inflence' is the y-axis title of Fig 1; Fig 2's caption runs the number into the title with no space ('Fig 2.Explanation'); Table 8 misspells Comparison as 'Camparson'; Table 3 numbers without a space ('Table3.'); Table 4's caption line is extracted twice on page 15; Table 9's header spends both T and G twice, and Table 21's header prints thirteen labels over twelve fields; Table 15 is titled 'Softball Coach Ranking' while listing baseball coaches; the appendix header spends G twice, on gender and on games; two coach names are truncated in the Original block ('Brenda Fres') and three are wrapped across the row in the Modified block; and the p35 map carries a half-cropped second figure at the left edge of one portrait.

Citation behaviour. Ten rows are never named by number (Fig 8, Fig 9, Fig 10, Fig 12, Fig 13, and Tables 1, 3, 6, 8, 17, 18, 19 - Table 6 and Table 3 are introduced by deixis, 'shown as follow.'), four are cited a page before they print (Fig 1 from page 12, Fig 4 from page 15, Fig 11 from page 28, Table 12 from page 27), and page 20 puts the number mid-sentence - 'in Fig 6. based on regression analysis'.
rules: Caption side splits by kind and holds throughout: every one of the fifteen figure captions prints below its art and every grid caption prints above its grid [caption.position]

The paper runs two independent number series - the summary sheet's bold 'Figure 1' and 'Figure 2' with no caption text, then the body's 'Fig 1.' to 'Fig 13' - so fifteen printed numbers cover sixteen exhibits once the unnumbered page-2 flow chart is counted [caption.numbering]

Ruling is three registers and no grid crosses them: the empirical SPSS grids are booktabs with three horizontal rules and no verticals at all, Table 1 is a boxed grid with open sides, and the two appendix data dumps are full grids with a rule under every row and a vertical at every column boundary [table.rule_style]
No grid in the paper bands a row and none shades a cell; the only colour is inside the figures and inside the coach portraits that sit in the cells of Tables 17 to 19 [table.zebra]
A grouped header prints as a spanner: Table 8 spanners 'before time optimized' and 'After time optimized' over two name columns, and that is the paper's only merged cell [table.merged_cells]
Only Table 8 carries two header rows; the seven sport grids carry one and the appendix dumps repeat a single header at the top of each block [table.header_rows]

Nine grids are set short of the text measure - 76 to 87 per cent, each measured and declared in its note - and the rest run full, so 'full' here means the wide bucket, not the exact measure [table.width]

Two grids print a header with more labels than the body has fields - Table 9 prints twelve labels over ten Sig. values and Table 21 thirteen over twelve - because a label column collapsed in typesetting [table.numeric_cols]
Decimals never align on the point: the SPSS values are right-aligned with ragged digit counts and the appendix blocks mix two, three and seven decimals in one column [table.decimal_aligned]

The heading detector is unusable on this paper - 112 heading records, every one with a null text, and section paths assembled from racing-result rows ('8 Bill Self M', '12 Different Factors') - so all forty section labels are the printed headings, which the text layer does carry verbatim, with section_numbered true [place.section_numbered]

Two of the sixteen figure rows are schematics the vocabulary cannot name more precisely: the three vector-angle illustrations are filed 'other' with an other_note, while the execution flow chart, the factor ladder and the factors pool land on the schematic family [geometry.family]
Every chart prints numbers on at least one axis; the schematic, the three vector diagrams and the map print no numbers at all, and only the map prints no labels either [geometry.printed_numbers]
Three charts key their series inside the frame and no chart ever keys outside it; the factors pool keys nothing and relies on the colour of its connectors [geometry.legend]
Nothing in the paper is three-dimensional and no colourbar appears anywhere [geometry.three_d]

Citation is optional here: ten of the sixteen figure rows and eight of the seventeen table rows are never cited by number at all, four figures are reached by deixis only, and the two appendix blocks have no numbering to cite [mention.count]
